description: Reads one stored VAT return receipt by its file name, which list_vat_receipts gives: what HMRC answered when it accepted the return, that is the processing date, the form bundle number, the payment indicator and the charge reference. clientId narrows the read to one of a practice's clients but does not change which receipt is read. Use this when the person asks for the HMRC receipt of a VAT return, its form bundle number, or whether HMRC accepted a return they filed. It does not file, change or resend anything.

clientId.description: A practice client's id, to check the receipt belongs to that client

name.description: The receipt file name, including .json (submit_vat_return answers receiptId without the suffix)

name: get_vat_receipt
title: Get a VAT receipt
